Name: Simple Faithful Sprites
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b][size=5]Simple Faithful Sprites[/size][/b]
Four-season clothing colours with the familiar Stardew Valley pixel-art look.

Simple Faithful Sprites gives 45 supported vanilla characters seasonal clothing colours while retaining their native faces, hair, silhouettes and animation layouts.

[heading][b]Recommended together: portraits + sprites[/b][/heading]
For a coordinated seasonal look, I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53441]Simple HD Portraits[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53442]Simple Faithful Sprites[/url] together. Both include seasonal artwork, with clothing colours designed to complement each other in dialogue portraits and world sprites. Each mod also works independently.
Simple Faithful Sprites provides spring, summer, autumn and winter palettes. The current Simple HD Portraits release uses standard outfits in spring, summer and autumn, plus original winter outfits where available. Sprite shapes remain faithful to the game, so fine outfit details can differ.

[heading][b]New in 1.7[/b][/heading]
[list]
[*]More consistent clothing colours during ordinary action poses, including music, work and sitting animations.[/*]
[*]Corrected winter coat masks, raised sleeves and hems, while preserving native trousers and footwear.[/*]
[*]Restored skin and arm colours where they had been mistaken for fabric.[/*]
[*]Cleaner jacket shades and denim boundaries.[/*]
[*]Stable material shading without shifting checker or noise patterns.[/*]
[/list][heading][b]Features[/b][/heading]
[list]
[*]Automatic spring, summer, autumn and winter clothing palettes across 45 supported vanilla characters.[/*]
[*]Native pixel scale, canvas sizes, faces, hair and animation positions.[/*]
[*]Seasonal clothing on supported ordinary action and kissing poses.[/*]
[*]Original mode and individual character switches.[/*]
[*]Optional Generic Mod Config Menu settings.[/*]
[*]Settings translated into all 12 built-in game languages.[/*]
[/list][heading][b]Compatibility and coverage[/b][/heading]
The mod preserves custom replacement sprite sheets instead of repainting unfamiliar artwork. Native winter sheets keep their winter palette when requested. Genuine special costumes and unsupported context artwork retain their native appearance.
Choose [b]Original[/b] to retain the loaded sprite artwork, or disable individual characters to mix sprite sets. The mod changes appearance only; dialogue, relationships, schedules and gameplay are unchanged.
[heading][b]Requirements[/b][/heading]
[b]Required:[/b] SMAPI 4.2.0 or newer on desktop Stardew Valley 1.6.
[b]Optional:[/b] Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game settings; [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53441]Simple HD Portraits[/url] for the companion portrait collection.
[heading][b]Installation and updates[/b][/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and extract Simple Faithful Sprites.[/*]
[*]Place the included [b]SimpleFaithfulSprites[/b] folder inside your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI. Seasonal artwork is enabled by default.[/*]
[/list]Close the game before updating. Keep your [b]config.json[/b] if you want to retain settings. If upgrading from the old [b]SimpleFaithful+Sprites[/b] folder, transfer its config.json into the new SimpleFaithfulSprites folder and remove the old mod folder so only one copy remains.
[heading][b]Settings[/b][/heading]
With Generic Mod Config Menu, enable or disable the mod, choose Seasonal or Original artwork and toggle individual characters. Without it, edit the config.json created after the first launch.
[heading][b]Credits[/b][/heading]
Original Stardew Valley sprite artwork by [b]ConcernedApe[/b].
Seasonal sprite edits and mod development by [b]xSyy[/b].
